expected.baseline: project synthetic registry hive (tiny SYSTEM); base block (regf magic, last_written FILETIME, root_cell_offset) validated; root NK cell name extraction validated; key paths cross-checked with python-registry output

guaranteedFields.name: hive_name
guaranteedFields.description: root key name extracted from root NK cell (UTF-16LE); falls back to 'unknown' on failure; note: not the filesystem filename

guaranteedFields.name: last_written
guaranteedFields.description: base block last_written FILETIME converted to UTC RFC 3339; null when FILETIME is zero or out of reasonable year range (2001-2099)

bestEffortFields.name: major_version
bestEffortFields.description: registry hive major version from base block

bestEffortFields.name: minor_version
bestEffortFields.description: registry hive minor version from base block

bestEffortFields.name: file_type
bestEffortFields.description: registry file type from base block (0 = primary, 1 = transaction log, etc.)

bestEffortFields.name: root_cell_offset
bestEffortFields.description: offset to root cell in hbin blocks; internal detail useful for debugging

bestEffortFields.name: hbin_data_size
bestEffortFields.description: first hbin block data size from base block

notGuaranteedFields.name: full_key_paths
notGuaranteedFields.description: complete registry key path enumeration; full hive traversal requires proper cell/bin parsing

notGuaranteedFields.name: value_data
notGuaranteedFields.description: individual registry value data (REG_SZ, REG_DWORD, REG_BINARY, etc.); not covered by current simplified parser

notGuaranteedFields.name: transaction_log_replay
notGuaranteedFields.description: LOG/LOG1/LOG2 transaction log replay; known limitation documented in parser-support-matrix.md

notGuaranteedFields.name: deleted_cell_recovery
notGuaranteedFields.description: recovery of deleted registry keys/values from unallocated cells; not supported

notGuaranteedFields.name: security_descriptor_parsing
notGuaranteedFields.description: SK cell security descriptor resolution; not implemented

expected.fieldNamingConvention: camelCase for top-level DTO; snake_case for attrs map keys within artifacts
expected.timezoneNormalizationRule: base block last_written FILETIME converted to UTC via Windows epoch offset (1601-01-01); serialized as RFC 3339; timestamps outside year range 2001-2099 are excluded

emptyValueStrategy.null: last_written FILETIME is zero or out of reasonable range
emptyValueStrategy.emptyString: hive_name defaults to 'unknown' or '(non-nk root)' when root NK cell signature is not 'nk'
emptyValueStrategy.zero: valid zero for sequence numbers and offsets
